label: Origin-deletion controls checked
description: Model-witnessed neutrality of the four encoded origin-tolerance commitments on individual deletion: with all four holding, deletion fails at a successor of actual (faithful, which is also the countermodel to Arrival A) or at actual itself (restored), and holds at every world (withEmpty, which adds a world with no individuals). So the encoded commitments entail neither deletion nor its failure, at actual, at accessible worlds or at every world. In withEmpty, by accessibleDeletionExcluded, one of presence-to-existence, inert emptiness or the possible contingent-free past at actual fails (here the past premise: b is no longer necessary at plus). Model claims concern these finite interpretations only; counterpart, vague or kind-relative tolerance readings are not tested.
